content.text:
All TypeScript errors in the `deploy-cloudflare` package are resolved. Here's a summary of what was fixed:

| Issue | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| `api.ts` used `../../../server/src/` (3 levels) from `src/worker/` — resolves to `packages/server/` | Changed to `../../../../server/src/` (4 levels to repo root) |
| `RunLogStoreType = "local_file"` caused `"r2"` to be rejected in R2 log stores | Extended to `"local_file" \| "r2"` in server source |
| `WorkspaceOperationLogStoreType` same issue | Same extension |
| `drizzle-orm@0.45.2` in CF package vs `0.38.4` in db package caused Drizzle type inference failures | Downgraded to `^0.38.4` to match |
| `R2Provider.getObject` returns `ReadableStream` (Web), server expects `Readable` (Node) | Cast as `never` in `registerStorageProvider` — intentional mismatch for CF runtime |
| `membershipRole: string | null` not assignable to `ActorMembership.membershipRole: string` | Map with `?? ""` coercion |
| `Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>` not assignable to `BufferSource` | Cast in `sha256Hex` call |
